triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · shell (2): remove the top bar; a persistent collapsible side menu holds the app name, search and avatar; the app menu only switches apps; banners move to the top of the content area; phase 1 of topic #36107 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size L.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Seat note · 2026-11-21T16:57Z · work that #36131 (#36111) leaves for this card. The L2 record 7066091185 on #36131 asked for it to be written here, so the thread that takes this card does not have to find it in that PR.

When this card removes the top bar, it also has to:
1. Turn the page-actions group on by default. #36131 ships it behind an app-shell context that defaults to off while the top bar exists.
2. Delete the guarded `localStorage['os:shell:page-actions']` switch that #36131 added for browser evidence.
3. Move the comments icon from #36114 (#36075) into the group's first position (fig. 45 order: comments, edit app, AI, help).
4. Check that no route nests two shell `PageHeader`s. Every `PageHeader` under the shell draws the group, so a nested pair would show it twice once it is on. No route nests two today (L2 nit on #36131).

Order: #36141 (menu icon tiles) goes before this card; both touch `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`.

Premise (thread, read on main `269fb670`, file `build-seat1/36112/premise.md` in the project folder): holds. Every top-bar item has a destination (section 1). Basis: card #36112; epic #36107; the seat note 7066108856 (work #36131 left here).
Split, as the thread proposes (the whole is about 2,400–3,200 lines):
- PR A, `Part of #36112`: everything moves. The desktop top bar goes; the sidebar's first and second rows and the avatar menu; the expand-button slot; banners and the connection notice at the top of the content area; ⌘⇧H moved; the page-actions group on by default, its `localStorage` switch deleted, and #36075's comments icon in the group's first position; the sidebar starts at the top of the screen. Today's auto-collapse and "keep sidebar open" stay as they are, so nothing is lost in between.
- PR B, `Fixes #36112`: the docking model, per the maintainer's answers to F1 and F2. F1: the card's "always docked, no keep-open switch" flips the merged auto-collapse below 1416px (#27593, #35062, ruling 6973617688). F2: "width remembered in the browser" was added by the coordinator, and the width is a fixed 256 today. Plus "recent" filtered to this app, and the full evidence set. Both forks are under Fable review and then go to the maintainer on decision cards; PR B waits for the answers.
The seat's reading of F3–F6: `/home` has no in-app entry in phase 1, and ⌘⇧H keeps working. "Add app" is admins only, with template and marketplace pointing to the same page as today. "About" stays in the help menu and is not duplicated. "Recent" lists this app's items only (card item 5).
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: PR A's code goes on fresh main after #36141 (PR #36164, same sidebar) merges; the comments-icon move needs #36114 merged. Seat note · 2026-11-21T17:37Z · #36112 item 2, "width and collapsed state remembered in the browser" (reviewed by fable, `build-seat1/36112/fable-decisions.md`)

The word "width" in item 2 was added by the coordinator (the card's own "coordinator additions" section says so); the maintainer never spoke about the sidebar's width, and no acceptance line mentions it. Today the sidebar is a fixed 256px with no drag-resize (`ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx:39`). So this card remembers only collapsed or expanded, per browser; the width stays 256 and drag-resize is not built. If it is wanted later, it is its own card. No maintainer question is needed for this.

The other fork (whether laptop-width windows start with the sidebar expanded or collapsed, which touches the merged auto-collapse below 1416px from #27593 and ruling 6973617688) is with the maintainer on a decision card. PR B waits for that answer; PR A keeps today's auto-collapse unchanged.

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T21:59Z · #36112 F1: whether the sidebar starts expanded or collapsed on laptop windows once the top bar is gone (reviewed by fable first, `build-seat1/36112/fable-decisions.md` in the project folder)

At 2026-11-21T21:58Z the maintainer picked option 0 on the seat's decision card, 「1280 起默认展开，更窄才收起」:

- Windows 1280 wide and up start with the sidebar expanded; 768 to 1279 start collapsed (today the threshold is 1416). 1280 is the seat's number, not one the maintainer set; a thread with a reason for another number says so on this card.
- The 「保持侧边栏展开」 switch goes; the expand/collapse button is the only control and the browser remembers it. A choice the user made wins over the default. Hovering the left edge still slides it out, ⌘B unchanged, phone unchanged, width fixed at 256 (F2, no ruling).
- Keep the threshold one constant, keep the wide and narrow choices stored separately as today, and read an existing `keepOpen = on` as "expanded on narrow".
- The accepted cost, stated on the card: on a 1280 window the list beside an open record drawer is 304 wide (560 today), and on 1280–1415 with the sidebar expanded, opening the comment panel returns the record page's fields to the tab row; collapsing the sidebar restores the three columns.
- The PR body states the upgrade change: on 1280–1415 windows, a user who never set 「保持展开」 now starts expanded.
- Text that names 1416 follows the change: the platform-core checklist step and the comment in `plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts`.

This is #36112 PR B (Fixes #36112), after PR A #36187 merges.

coordinator#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oZMPktvZ9t3TrZP3d

Ruling: letter B · maintainer 「B ⌘B 和按钮一样固定展开」 · 2026-11-22T05:07Z

The maintainer (Leehom) tapped option B on the decision card in the project's decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRrmBvi6HoMXTh5eXfazCz5` (card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1sczozCuhfKZa5p3dskfo4`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XL8iaUvpMVd2MqvAkmsTzhL`, 2026-11-22T05:06:51Z). It answers the open question of report 7074501487. The option text on the card: 「⌘B 等于点这个按钮：收起、再按回到页面旁边并记住。临时浮出只留给鼠标移到左边缘。一个小的后续改动。」

**Ruled:**

- ⌘B / Ctrl+B does what a press on the sidebar's expand/collapse button does. Expanded, it collapses the sidebar; collapsed, it docks the sidebar beside the page; the browser remembers either.
- The temporary float over the page stays only on the window's left edge.
- This replaces the words "⌘B unchanged" of ruling 7069868269 (F1) on this card, and the shortcut half of "on the top-bar trigger (and its shortcut)" in ruling 6973617688 on #35062. The maintainer was told before the tap that B changes the F1 record's wording. Every other line of both rulings stands.

Not taken: A (leave as shipped: the button docks, ⌘B floats, the tooltip names ⌘B), C (⌘B keeps floating and the button's tooltip stops naming it).

Stated to the maintainer before the tap: the cost is that the keyboard can no longer peek at the menu without changing the layout (two presses of ⌘B instead); nobody was measured depending on the ⌘B float, which shipped on 2026-11-18 with PR #35187; the statement that comparable products bind the sidebar shortcut to the docked toggle was written from knowledge and not checked in this session.

**Execution (from the decision thread's analysis; items below this line are the thread's reading, not text on the tapped card):**

- PR #36297 is not changed by this ruling and lands as it is. B is one small follow-up PR on the `ui/` surface (not governed), dispatched by seat `repo:objectstack#4` in area a4-H after #36297 merges, with `Ruling-ref:` this comment.
- One rule: in every state ⌘B equals a press on the button. Collapsed by hand on a wide window or collapsed by default on a narrow one, ⌘B docks; on a narrow window it also keeps the narrow-window choice as expanded, as the button's press does. While the menu floats, ⌘B docks it. Focus does not move, as with a button press.
- Unchanged: the left edge's hover and press float; Esc, a chosen entry and an outside press fold a float; the phone; the 1280 threshold; the width.
- Text that follows: the comments in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/consoleSidebarRail.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useResponsiveSidebar.ts` that say ⌘B floats; step 3 of `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` ("or press Ctrl/⌘+B … to float"), with a revision bump; a changeset.
- Tests: the cases in `UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062.test.tsx` and `UnifiedSidebar.railOverlay-27593.test.tsx` that float with ⌘B float from the left edge instead; new cases pin that ⌘B docks on both sides of the threshold and that a reload keeps it.
- The follow-up PR's body cites this record and names the two ruling lines it replaces. Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none.

Analysis: `pm-orders/objectstack/36112-cmdb-decision-analysis.md` in the project folder.

Prior rulings read: sidebar,shortcut,keepopen,float,dock → 1 hits; ADR-0158 Decision §8 (units of measure, matched on "float", unrelated); thread: 7069868269; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack (plus 6973617688 on #35062, read).
